header.title: Live Test Experience
header.description: Controls what learners see while attempting an assessment, on both web and mobile.

calculator.label: Calculator
calculator.description: Show an on-screen calculator inside the test.
calculator.hint: Scientific adds trigonometry and its inverses, logarithms, powers and roots, factorial, π and e, and a DEG/RAD toggle.

scratchpad.label: Scratchpad
scratchpad.description: A rough-work notepad. Its contents are never submitted with the paper.

questionPalette.label: Question palette
questionPalette.description: Lets learners jump between questions and see answered / marked status.

markingScheme.label: Show marking scheme on each question
markingScheme.description: Displays the marks awarded and deducted beside every question.

mobileNav.label: Hide app navigation on mobile
mobileNav.description: During a live test on a phone, hide the chatbot launcher and other app chrome so only the assessment is visible.
